correctness.rationale: The exact coding identity for survival uses an eight-state binary de Bruijn graph with precisely two forbidden edges. Perron–Frobenius/Gelfand gives the infinite-time escape exponent; trace/determinant gives symbolic zeta. For each of all 120 pairs an integer characteristic polynomial is computed; square-free rational Sturm sequences isolate the largest positive root in one of 16 disjoint intervals with no larger positive roots, yielding 26 distinct polynomials, 16 spectral radii and all exact equality cases. A separate direct binary enumeration gives 960 matching finite-time counts, not substituted for an infinite proof. Symbolic endpoint caveat is explicit.

value.rationale: This natural finite benchmark exhausts all equally sized two-hole configurations at fixed four-digit resolution, precisely where overlap and cross-correlation obscure simple monotone comparisons for the binary alphabet. It gives the complete spectrum of escape/entropy values, all sharp extremizers, and a nontrivial 26-versus-16 separation between periodic-word zeta data and a single asymptotic escape exponent. It is a complete invariant classification rather than a minor numerical improvement; the precisely finite scope is intrinsic and does not claim an all-length theorem.
